title: Production Launch Readiness
decisionRationale: All automatable regression baselines are green (typecheck, 343 validations, 38/38 Playwright + 0 serious/critical axe, production build, RC-2 perf budgets, RC-2 DB analysis). All critical/high security findings from RC-3 are fixed. The four operator-only launch prerequisites (Google OAuth, distributed rate-limit adapter env, API bearer rotation, pre-launch baseline backup) remain BLOCKED-OPERATOR by design. GA readiness is NOT claimed.

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTER=supabase in production env
hardLaunchPrerequisites.evidence: src/lib/data/rate-limit.ts::assertRateLimitReadiness fail-closes in production without this env; verified in startupDiagnostics.

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: Google OAuth provider enabled in Cloud
hardLaunchPrerequisites.evidence: Not enabled via configure_social_auth in this environment; sign-in path requires provider before first user OAuth.

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: APIC-001 demo bearer retired; production APIClient rows created
hardLaunchPrerequisites.evidence: resolveClient() in src/routes/api/public/v1/$.ts only trusts APIC-001 when DEMO_API_KEY env matches (unset in prod).

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: pre-launch-baseline backup created + verified
hardLaunchPrerequisites.evidence: performBackup + verifyBackupIntegrity in src/lib/data/backups.ts; no baseline row in workspace yet.
